about: Sources the weekly watch ritual checks for news the studio should act on (Director, 2026-10-13). `rnd watch` reports what is new since the last check; the ritual's scout reads and ranks it. Add a source by pull request, and say why it matters.

sources.why: NVIDIA's developer posts: models, tools and techniques; the NVIDIA newsletter draws on it
the current CUDA toolkit version; driver minimums and Blackwell support for the RTX 5090
new NVIDIA open models (Nemotron and others) that might fit the 5090
the skills catalogue mirrored in catalogs/nvidia-skills; run `rnd catalog sync` when it moves
the LAN router compared with interlock (briefs/pair-and-interlock)
NVIDIA's real-time streaming AI and robotic-control SDK (v5.0.0 GA 2026-10-21, CUDA 13); a candidate runtime for later robotics-in-simulation work, so new stable releases should reach the watch
the 5090 serving engine; a new version can change behaviour the experiments depend on
the engine under Ollama; report notable releases only
the Intel NPU and iGPU lane
training and GPU work; CUDA support changes
the agent CLI every harness and experiment runs on; flags and permission rules change
Docker's posts: Sandboxes, Model Runner, agent permissions, and Hub security advisories (Director, 2026-10-13)
the sbx CLI and cloud sandboxes, the isolated machines an agent experiment can run in; candidate for the $250 credit offer
Docker Desktop on the rig: WSL 2, GPU support and Model Runner changes
the container engine under Docker Desktop and the Linux hosts (RunPod pods run containers)
Docker's local model serving; a possible lane beside Ollama on the 5090
